meaning_by_symbol.split: clashing tones; two patterns or configurations fighting
meaning_by_symbol.pulse: opposite faces pulsing bright and dark in sync with a hum; a two-tone hum
meaning_by_symbol.corners: one to two corners blazing, with clicking near them, and hot there
meaning_by_symbol.blaze: all faces blinding white, with a harsh buzz, and heat radiating
meaning_by_symbol.hollow: normal surface, dark center, hollow tap, thin hum
meaning_by_symbol.drift: colors sliding, edges blurred, hum with wavering pitch
meaning_by_symbol.echo: too bright, layered or stacked tones, frozen patterns
meaning_by_symbol.leak: corners dim, edges fading, hollow thin hum at the edges
meaning_by_symbol.low: all faces dim, whisper hum, washed-out
meaning_by_symbol.reson: one face much brighter, with a whine near it
meaning_by_symbol.soft: edges wobble, faces bulging, muffled hum
meaning_by_symbol.OK: clean success with no new symptoms
meaning_by_symbol.P1: Sound a sustained {intensity} tone near all six faces simultaneously for {duration} seconds, starting from the {face} face. Let the tone fade naturally and wait for the hum to stabilize.
meaning_by_symbol.P2: Chime a bell near two opposite faces, starting from the {face} face. Alternate the chime between the two faces, with a {duration}-second pause between chimes, for five cycles at {intensity} tone.
meaning_by_symbol.P3: Drape a cloth over two adjacent edges near the {face} face for {duration} seconds at {intensity} coverage. Then chime a bell three times near the {face} face.
meaning_by_symbol.P4: Warm each corner of the {face} face by holding a heated stone nearby for {duration} seconds at {intensity} warmth, in sequence. Then trace each edge of the {face} face with a finger.
meaning_by_symbol.P5: Place a warm stone beside the {face} face at {intensity} warmth for {duration} seconds. Rotate and repeat for each face.
meaning_by_symbol.P6: Drape a cool cloth over the Veyru for {duration} seconds. Remove the cloth and fan {intensity} cool air across the {face} face and the opposite face for {duration} seconds.
meaning_by_symbol.P7: Illuminate the {face} face with a dim lamp and the opposite face with a bright lamp simultaneously at {intensity} brightness for {duration} seconds, without moving the lamps.
meaning_by_symbol.P8: Drape a folded cloth over the {face} face for {duration} seconds at {intensity} coverage. Then chime a bell near each edge of the {face} face twice.
meaning_by_symbol.P9: At each corner of the {face} face, chime a bell briefly at {intensity} tone, then warm the two edges meeting at that corner with a heated stone for {duration} seconds.
meaning_by_symbol.P10: Rest a flat board against the {face} face at {intensity} contact for {duration} seconds. Rotate and repeat for each face-pair.
meaning_by_symbol.P11: Chime a bell near the center of each face once at {intensity} tone, starting from the {face} face. Then place a warm stone beside the Veyru for {duration} seconds.
meaning_by_symbol.P12: Place the Veyru on a soft surface with the {face} face up at {intensity} contact. Let it rest undisturbed for {duration} seconds.
meaning_by_symbol.P13: Drape a cool cloth over the Veyru for {duration} seconds. Remove and fan {intensity} cool air across all six faces for {duration} seconds, starting from the {face} face.
meaning_by_symbol.P14: Rotate the Veyru slowly over {duration} seconds while sounding a steady tone at {intensity} volume near opposite faces, starting from the {face} face. After rotation, chime a bell once near each corner.

reply.rationale: No defensible multi-entry compositional paradigm survives the evidence tests. The strongest apparent family, P1–P14, fails the opaque-index test: the numerals do not contribute literal count or other compositional meaning to the procedure codes, but merely distinguish stored procedures. So P1, P2, ... P14 remain whole lexical labels, not P + NUMBER entries. The proposed suffix families also fail: hollow/low do not support a stable shared contribution for -ow, and drift/soft do not support a stable shared contribution for -ft; the residues likewise do not form a coherent substitution class in a shared meaning frame. Although standalone symbols such as L/R/F/B/T/Bot/K/D/top/front/back and g/m/s look like possible face or intensity value inventories, there are no actual segmented code entries in this codebook where those fillers alternate inside a shared morphotactic construction. Since false morphology is worse than a flat lexicon, all supplied symbols are treated as lexical_symbols and classes/constructions/entries remain empty.
